Stuck on something? Here's where to turn.

## Report a bug or request a feature

Each package tracks issues in its own repository. File the issue on the
package that's misbehaving — that's the fastest route to a fix.

::: {.package-grid}
[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-box}[aniframe]{.package-name}[Data structures]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/anicore]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/anicore/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-download}[aniread]{.package-name}[Read & write]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/aniread]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/aniread/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-clipboard-check}[anicheck]{.package-name}[Data quality]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/anicheck]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/anicheck/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-gear}[aniprocess]{.package-name}[Processing]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/aniprocess]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/aniprocess/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-bounding-box}[anispace]{.package-name}[Spatial transformations]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/anispace]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/anispace/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-bar-chart}[animetric]{.package-name}[Metrics]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/animetric]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/animetric/issues){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-graph-up}[anivis]{.package-name}[Visualization]{.package-role}[github.com/animovement/anivis]{.package-desc}](https://github.com/animovement/anivis/issues){.package-card}
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Not sure which package is at fault? Open the issue on the
[animovement metapackage](https://github.com/animovement/animovement/issues) and
we'll route it.
:::

## Ask a question

For usage questions and general discussion, use
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/animovement/discussions). Searching
existing discussions first often turns up an answer straight away.

## Contribute

*animovement* is open source and community-driven. Contributions — code, docs,
bug reports, tutorials — are all welcome. Start from the contributing guide in
any package repository on [GitHub](https://github.com/animovement).
